title: Commission Tier/Flat — the band removed by a copy has a blank Currency in History (NM-4692 regression)
requirementSource: NM-4692: History Currency must show the currency (e.g. USD) for records with Action = Remove made by a copy
stepsToReproduce: Open Setup → Commissions → Tier/Flat for office 1101 (/navigator/locations/1101/commissions/tiers) on e2e and click Search.
Add a band on ZSub Rental Specialty (0 – 99,999,901) and one on ZSub Contractor Specialty Labor (5 – 99,999,901); Save.
Copy → Copy Within Location: source ZSub Rental Specialty, tick ZSub Contractor Specialty Labor, Apply (confirm the overwrite).
Open the Commission Tier/Flat History tab.
expectedBehavior: The Remove entry of the overwritten 5 – 99,999,901 band shows USD.
actualBehavior: Its Currency is blank; every other Remove of the same band (made by a normal delete) shows USD.

verificationLog.finding: History of the copy at 08:45 (isolated rerun) — Remove with blank Currency, next to earlier Remove entries with USD.
